title: Fix crash when trying to add a non-Node as a child
body:
When trying to execute the following:

var n = load("res://node_2d.tscn")
add_child(n)

(note the missing .instantiate())

The engine crashes with a segfault. The parameter to Node::add_child() is converted to a Node but it is actually a PackedScene.

When trying to call .get_name() on this we end up calling into non-existant code and we crash.

Add a helpful error for the most common way of achieving this, and a generic error for any other case.
